name: Jasper
tagline: An AI content platform for marketing teams that keeps output in line with a company's brand.
bestFor: Marketing teams that need on-brand copy at volume
description: Jasper is an AI platform for marketing teams that combines agents, brand context (Jasper IQ) and a Canvas workspace for creating campaign content. It sells a self-serve Pro plan per seat and a custom-priced Business plan that adds API access, SSO and unlimited users.
pros: 7-day free trial of the Pro plan
Brand Voices, Knowledge assets and Audiences on every plan
cons: API access only on the custom-priced Business plan
Plagiarism checking is a Copyscape add-on, not native

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per seat; includes 1 seat. Annual is billed up front with a 12-month commitment. 2 Brand Voices, 5 Knowledge assets, 3 Audiences. Contact sales to add more users.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Custom pricing, 12-month minimum. Unlimited Brand Voices and users, API access, SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM, priority support.

integrations: Webflow, Google Docs, Slack and an integrations marketplace

name: Copy.ai
tagline: An AI platform for go-to-market teams that runs chat and automated workflows for sales and marketing.
bestFor: Go-to-market teams automating sales and marketing workflows
description: Copy.ai is an AI platform for sales, marketing and operations teams that offers multi-model chat plus workflow automation for tasks such as prospecting and content creation. Pricing starts with a flat 5-seat Chat plan and rises to workflow-credit tiers priced per month for the whole team.
pros: Chat plan includes 5 seats and unlimited chat words
Access to OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini models
Brand Voice and Infobase for company context
cons: No free plan listed on the pricing page
Workflow tiers start at $1,000 per month
API access only on the custom Enterprise plan

plans.name: Chat
plans.notes: Flat price for the workspace, includes 5 seats. Annual billed $288/yr. Unlimited words in chat and unlimited chat projects.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Flat price, includes 75 seats. Annual billed $12,000/yr. 20K workflow credits per month.

plans.name: Expansion
plans.notes: Flat price, includes 150 seats. Annual billed $24,000/yr. 45K workflow credits per month.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Flat price, includes 200 seats. Annual billed $36,000/yr. 75K workflow credits per month.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Unlimited customizable workflows, API access and bulk workflow runs, 20+ tech integrations, a dedicated account and support team.

integrations: Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Zapier, Outreach, Salesloft

name: Writesonic
tagline: An AI search visibility platform that tracks brand mentions in AI engines and writes content to improve them.
bestFor: Marketing teams tracking and improving visibility in AI search
description: Writesonic now positions itself as a platform that tracks how brands appear in ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and other AI engines, then suggests fixes. Every plan also includes monthly AI articles, site audits and brand writing styles.
pros: 7-day free trial, no credit card needed
AI articles, site audits and AI-visibility tracking in one plan
SOC 2 Type II and GDPR compliance
cons: Entry plan starts at $79/month billed annually
Extra users cost $50/user/month and plans cap at 5 users

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Flat price, 1 user. 1 project, 50 prompts tracked daily, 15 AI articles/month, 10 site audits/month, 1 writing style. Monthly price derived from the vendor's stated yearly saving.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Flat price, 2 users included; up to 3 more at $50/user/month. 100 prompts tracked daily, 25 AI articles/month, 20 site audits/month, 5 writing styles. Monthly price derived from the stated yearly saving.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Flat price, 3 users included; up to 2 more at $50/user/month. 2 projects, 200 prompts tracked daily, 50 AI articles/month, 50 site audits/month, 10 writing styles. Monthly price derived from the stated yearly saving.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. All 8 AI platforms tracked, SSO/SAML, user access control, dedicated support.

integrations: WordPress, Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio

name: Rytr
tagline: A low-cost AI writing assistant that also drafts follow-up messages from your email, Slack and calendar.
bestFor: Individuals who want a cheap AI writer with a free tier
description: Rytr is an AI writing assistant that now also connects to email, Slack, calendar and meeting notes to track commitments and draft messages for review. It has a free-forever tier and paid plans from $9 per month.
pros: Free-forever plan with 10,000 characters per month
Writes in your own voice or one of 22 tones
cons: Yearly prices are not shown on the pricing page
Higher tiers are built around relationship tracking, not long-form writing
freePlanDetails: 10,000 characters/month, 1 connected source, 40+ use cases, 30+ languages.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: Unlimited characters/month. Yearly billing saves 20%, but the yearly price is not shown.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: Unlimited characters, 2 connected sources. Yearly saves 20% (price not shown).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: All connected sources, custom use cases, morning and evening briefings. Yearly saves 20% (price not shown).

integrations: Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Google Calendar, Google Meet
